description: Eerste Helmersstraat 209-213 (1897): 6 m red-brown brick fronts of four storeys under a deep cream moulded cornice at 14 m; three equal axes of two-light windows with a transom; storeys 0-2 under segmental brick heads with a patterned ochre tympanum and a white keystone, the top storey flat-headed with a keystone; white painted bands run across the front at the transom and the springing line of each window storey; white sills; one white timber dormer with a pediment

pediment-dormer.note: 211, 213: one white timber dormer with a pediment and a finial, centred

door-right.note: 213: double house door on the right axis under the segmental head; windows with a transom

rhythm.identicalBays: every storey: 3 two-light windows with a transom, one width
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; door on the right (213)
rhythm.roofline: deep cream cornice at 14 m; one pediment dormer

match.note: Eerste Helmersstraat 209-213 (1897): four storeys, cornice 14 m on the strip; PDOK eaves 14.5-16.4 (mansard and dormers)

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-11-29 pands 1-2 (211A, 213) at 2x with a metre grid: ground windows 0.5-3.3 m under segmental heads to 3.6, storey-1 windows 4.3-6.6 m, storey-2 7.2-9.6, storey-3 10.5-12.6 flat with keystones, cornice 13.1-14.0; white bands at 5.9 (transom) and 6.6 (springing) on storey 1, 8.9 and 9.6 on storey 2; ochre patterned tympana; white keystones

schemaLimits: the relieving arch field is a flat ochre fill (palette band); the photo shows a small chequer of moulded brick
the top storey keystone over the flat heads is not drawn (keystones follow the relieving arches only)
